cases.assertion: Existing v1 payload, bytes, approval and projection behavior remain unchanged.
Visible inline order, author/public source facts and exact accepted CTA targets agree with gift HTML; private/future targets do not leak.
A 31+ page source is fully represented by an accepted bounded contract or explicitly rejected; never silently sliced.
Over 18000 characters have declared complete-source semantics; a retrieval excerpt never claims full import.
T-1/T/T+1 and a prior cached response follow the accepted publication and revocation predicate.
Over 30 revoked hashes retain complete coverage, revision fencing and retry semantics across every batch.
An absent or invalid gift source does not prevent existing six accepted sources from refreshing.
A mapping retry preserves business_id; environment scope is distinct from the global business registry.
Registration alone grants no external channel, commerce or learning promotion; source ingest sends nothing.
Missing gift corpus/release prevents gift learning admission without disabling existing six niches.
Unsupported legacy ID, timestamp, name, message, consent or status is visible as a migration exception, never fabricated.
Wrong site/environment/stream identity is rejected without partial Case or checkpoint mutation.
Source ID normalization and reader ordering agree for records with the same timestamp.
Concurrent identical import creates one CaseSource/Case and no notification or voice session.
Legacy and shared-form streams cannot accidentally share one independent cursor or duplicate migrated customers.
Older late inserts have an explicit reconciliation path; ordinary watermark scanning does not falsely claim they were imported.
Rollback does not rewind the checkpoint, drop new leads or resurrect erased PII.
Existing policies, active/versions files, contacts and per-site behavior remain isolated and unchanged by gift onboarding.
